definitions.registered_visitors: Persistent face identities currently registered (global, ignores the filters). Erased visitors are not counted.
definitions.unique_visitors_in_scope: Distinct registered identities with at least one visit entering in scope. Faces that were not reliably recognised are not included.
definitions.returning_visitors_in_scope: Unique visitors in scope with an in-scope visit in a session other than the one in which they were first registered.
definitions.visits: Presence episodes (one visitor, one session). The same visitor can have many.
definitions.entry_events: Logical entry events of the visits in scope (one per visit).
definitions.terminal_events: Logical ends of the visits in scope: exits (left the view / observation ended) and interruptions. None is a verified physical departure.
definitions.active_visits: Open visits of live sessions right now (date range ignored). Open rows of sessions that are not live are stale and not counted.
definitions.unresolved_tracks: Historical diagnostic: evaluated tracks without a resolved identity. Never extra people.
